    <text x="36" y="444" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">where neighbors can meet, rest, and</text>
    <text x="36" y="466" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">connect. The movement is reshaping</text>
    <text x="36" y="488" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#E4E6EB">the everyday rhythm of urban life.</text>
